verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an ACP-based checkout flow. Agent checkout requests trigger create and update calls that move a checkout session through documented statuses, and embedded mode covers cart management for agent builders. The caveats are significant: access is private-preview, OCA-gated and waitlisted, and the evidence describes the seller-side reverse API rather than the agent-side call shapes. Missing for 10: documented agent-side request schemas for creating and updating a cart, general availability beyond private preview, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cart or draft updates.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can create and update a cart or order draft through a documented protocol call

citations.quote: When an agent routes a checkout request through Stripe, Stripe calls these endpoints on your behalf.
incomplete | ready_for_payment | requires_escalation | processing | completed | canceled
the full checkout lifecycle through Stripe, including product feed ingestion, cart management, fulfillment, and payment collection
This feature is in private preview.
